observations: Photo 0 shows a black Sony PlayStation 4 console with a split chassis.
A retail box for a Sony DualShock 4 Wireless Controller is placed on top of the console.
The box text reads 'SONY PS4 DUALSHOCK 4 Wireless Controller'.
The console has a matte black finish and the 'PS4' logo is visible on the right side panel.
The console appears to be in a clean, indoor environment.
A watermark 'KING AUTOS AND GADGETS' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The exterior looks clean in the photo, but internal condition and the presence of dust or fungus are not visible.
Origin and import status cannot be confirmed from a single photo.
No games are visible on the console or in the photo.
The box in photo 0 contains the controller and its charging cable.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu.

risks.risk: The console may have a 'Digital' firmware version which cannot be upgraded to 'Original' firmware.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the System Information screen showing the firmware version.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the system settings.
Screenshot of the System Information screen showing the firmware version.
Video of the console connected to the internet and logged into the PlayStation Network.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PlayStation 4 from the retail box. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (not working) until proof of operation is provided.
